cd /workspace/tmp && cat > special.py <<'EOF'
import itertools, json, subprocess, sys, time, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import ref

def run(obj):
    data=json.dumps(obj).encode()
    t0=time.perf_counter()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=data,capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, json.loads(p.stdout.decode()), time.perf_counter()-t0, len(data)

def hamiltonian(nodes):
    return [list(p) for p in itertools.permutations(nodes)]

# K4: all 24 hamiltonian paths -> 6 core links
nodes=[1,2,3,4]
rib=[{'path':p,'count':random.Random(len(p)).randint(1,50)} for p in hamiltonian(nodes)]
links=set()
for p in rib:
    for a,b in zip(p['path'],p['path'][1:]): links.add((min(a,b),max(a,b)))
links=sorted(links)
# find a width<=4 order via ref helpers
import gen
def norm(p): return p
agg={}
for r in rib: agg[tuple(r['path'])]=agg.get(tuple(r['path']),0)+r['count']
rnd,cur=gen.peel(agg)
core=sorted(set(links)-set(rnd))
print("K4 core",core,"rounds",rnd)
order=gen.find_order(core,cur)
print("order",order)
data={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':order,
      'queries':[{'id':'q1','path':[1,2,3,4],'threshold':[1,2]},{'id':'q2','path':[4,3,2,1],'threshold':[1,2]}]}
exp=ref.solve(data)
rc,got,t,nb=run(data)
def close(a,b):
    if type(a) is dict: return set(a)==set(b) and all(close(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
    if type(a) is list: return type(b) is list and len(a)==len(b) and all(close(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    if type(a) is float: return type(b) in (int,float) and abs(a-b)<=1e-9
    return type(a) is type(b) and a==b
print("K4 match:", close(exp,got), "time %.3f"%t)
if not close(exp,got):
    print(json.dumps(exp,indent=1)); print(json.dumps(got,indent=1))

# K5: all 120 hamiltonian paths -> width violation
nodes5=[1,2,3,4,5]
rib5=[{'path':p,'count':1} for p in hamiltonian(nodes5)]
agg5={}
for r in rib5: agg5[tuple(r['path'])]=agg5.get(tuple(r['path']),0)+r['count']
rnd5,cur5=gen.peel(agg5)
links5=set()
for p in rib5:
    for a,b in zip(p['path'],p['path'][1:]): links5.add((min(a,b),max(a,b)))
core5=sorted(links5-set(rnd5))
print("K5 core size",len(core5),"rounds",rnd5)
order5=[[a,b] for a,b in sorted(core5)]
data5={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib5,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':order5,'queries':[]}
rc,got,t,nb=run(data5)
print("K5 (width violation) ->",got,"time %.3f"%t)

# 66-cycle: >64 core links
n=66
paths=[]
for s in range(n):
    p=[((s+k)%n)+1 for k in range(64)]
    paths.append({'path':p,'count':1})
order66=[]
for s in range(n):
    a=((s)%n)+1; b=((s+1)%n)+1
    order66.append([min(a,b),max(a,b)])
data66={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':paths,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':order66,'queries':[]}
rc,got,t,nb=run(data66)
print("66-cycle ->",got,"time %.3f"%t,"bytes",nb)

# >4096 distinct rib links
rib_big=[]
base=1
for i in range(66):
    p=list(range(base, base+64)); base+=64
    rib_big.append({'path':p,'count':1})
datab={'version':1,'ixps':[],'rib':rib_big,'priors':[],'declared':[],'order':[],'queries':[]}
rc,got,t,nb=run(datab)
print("4158 links ->",str(got)[:120],"time %.3f"%t,"bytes",nb)
